Armed with the ambition, necessity and idealism of youth, Charlize, Kheng, and Sani enter the Prison Service with very different goals. Behind prison walls, the rookies quickly learn that the job is not just about discipline and control, but trust, rehabilitation and second chances. They will learn some of their most valuable lessons about life, love and sacrifice from the people they least expect — inmates, colleagues, ex-convicts and their families.

Best Telenovela - National Winner Asian Academy Creative Awards (2020) | Kin is a drama about the complexities of life, love and family relationships. Years have passed since Yoke and Ella had their lives turned upside-down when they returned to be with their rightful families after having been swapped at birth. Years later, Yoke has seemingly embraced her role as a status-conscious, high society Shelley, assuming a leadership role in the family business. Ella has accepted her fate as a member of the salt of the earth, working-class Loh family but struggles to make something of her life. Has the nature vs nurture battle run its course or are relationships between the families still as fraught and complicated as ever? The Lohs, Shelleys, Hassans, and Balas have overcome personal loss, incarceration, as well as estrangement of their loved ones; yet lingering tensions remain. Mysteries continue to unfold as characters pursue their individual agendas, while emotional drama abounds as surprising twists are revealed that threaten the stability to which they have become accustomed..

Grab your camera and get ready for a global backstreet tour! Each episode of this series links up with a local photographer who knows the best spots in town for great pictures, fascinating facts, and unforgettable adventures.

Brand new series where the UK's most passionate cooks get a once-in-a-lifetime chance to launch their own food brand to the British public. Cooking Up a Fortune sees amateur foodies, who dream of escaping the rat race and cooking for a living, create and sell their dishes to hundreds of real diners in a purpose-built food arena. Each week the winning kitchen gets to launch their idea for a food business to paying customers in one of Europe's busiest food markets.

Three generations of the Jin family live under one roof. Mrs. Jin-Ke mei-man has two sons, You-Tsai and You-De. You-Tsai abandoned the family many years ago, leaving his wife Siou-Ying to shoulder the huge responsibility of the Jin family business selling fish products at market. Although Siou-Ying was betrayed by You-Tsai, she has still been a dutiful daughter to her mother-in-law, and has single-mindedly raised four children. 三代同堂的金家，奶奶金柯美满，膝下有两子-有财跟有德。有财早年抛弃家庭离开，妻子秀英一肩扛下金家重责大任，在市场从事贩卖鱼货的工作。虽然有财对不起秀英在先，但秀英仍然孝顺婆婆，也拉拔彦钧等四个孩子长大。透过金家的故事，除了体会婚姻的酸与甜，还得面对婆媳、姑嫂、妯娌间的「那些小事」…，也透视到家庭与爱情真正爱的真谛！

Traumatized policeman Ben delves into his own past to investigate a cold case obscured by a web of guilt, lies and deception. In the process, Marion, a doctor, helps him come to terms with himself and his past.

A fatal arson incident draws Helen Dorn into a far-left extremist community, who has targeted wealthy real estate agent Ralph Wagner. While they deny any involvement in the crime, it is indeed suspicious that they were previously almost ousted by Wagner.
Fusi is in his forties and yet to find courage to enter the adult world. He sleepwalks through everyday life, where routine is key. Unexpected events force him to make drastic decisions.

A witty dramedy about a racist and broke hotel owner, Primus, who starts a refugee asylum centre at his mountain resort. He meets Abedi, an annoying optimist who takes him on one hell of a ride but ultimately, changes his life and touches his heart.

A week in the life of Moha, Valero and Pep - workers in a small plumbing and electricity company in the outskirts of Barcelona, Spain. Moha is on a one-week trial period and is set to replace Pep, but Valero doesn't think he has what it takes.

Bruno, a stay-at-home father of two, gets back in touch with his masculinity when his wife is kidnapped in Marseille. Instead of the planned holiday on the Côte d'Azur, Bruno gets deeper and deeper into an intrigue, pursued by police and mafia.

Ranging from a 60-year-old retiree who no longer finds herself desirable to a daughter trying to make her breakthrough as a model, five women of different ages confront their self-image and the expectation they have for themselves and the people around them.
The pursuit of a 4-year-old innocent Dev, wanting to play with his grandfather, but isn't allowed to by his parents as unknown to him, his grandfather is in a coma.

Felix enjoys his single life to the fullest, but a ferret bites him, sterilizing him in the process. He tries everything in his power to find the soon-to-be mother of his only child, the result of his first and last sperm donation.

Ukrainian immigrant Irina lives with her son Igor in a small Czech border town. When she discovers that Igor has been assaulted by three Romas her whole world comes crashing down. As times goes on, Irina begins to spot inconsistencies in his story.

After his divorce, 55-year-old Domingo embarks on a belated journey to fulfil his lifelong dream – to become a sports commentator. Though he aspires to join the local TV station, his commentaries are unknowingly leaving an impact on his community.

p.t: The Boy Who Wants To Live
p.d: 70-year-old Willi catches Malian refugee Nama stealing, but decides not to report him. Having been a refugee once, Willi sees a part of himself in Nama, and brings him home. However, Nama’s decision further frays his relationship with his son.

p.t: Temasek Shophouse: Honouring the Past, Inspiring the Future
p.d: Along Orchard Road, four historic shophouses are about to begin a new life. Built across different eras and for different purposes, they are being brought together to form an expanded Temasek Shophouse — a hub for social impact. But transforming century-old buildings comes with unexpected challenges. Architects, conservation specialists and engineers must decide what to preserve, find ways to connect four very different structures, and make them more sustainable without erasing their character. As hidden features are uncovered and old materials find new uses, the team races to turn an ambitious vision into reality — and prove that heritage, sustainability and new possibilities can coexist.

They trusted her. Then, a series of mysterious deaths raised a chilling question: what, if anything, connected them? At the centre of the case is Sararat Rangsiwuthaporn, widely known as “Aem Cyanide”, whom police came to suspect in a number of deaths across Thailand. What began as an investigation into individual cases soon widened as police uncovered possible connections between them. Cyanide became a key focus, while questions emerged over money and the ‘sharing circle’ relationships which Aem had with some who died. With rare access to those closest to the case, the series goes inside an investigation that gripped Thailand and left families searching for answers. As new details come to light, it traces how suspicion fell on Aem and examines the evidence that turned a series of mysterious deaths into one of Thailand’s most extraordinary criminal investigations.
Spotlight on East Asia, a region steeped in history and now helping to write the future of our world. We'll break down the key stories and explain why they matter.

p.t: Thomas Edison's Secret Lab - Fungal Bungle / Water Friends For?
p.d: Kent’s extreme attempts to cure his toe fungus in time for a pool party cause the fungus to mutate and grow into a fungus-based replica of Kent himself. The Secret Lab Kids have to stop the replicant before it turns the whole lab into a stinky, sticky fungus-farm. / When Kent manages to contact aliens, they land at the Edison complex and demand that the Secret Lab kids help them find a very valuable "treasure" that their planet needs. The trouble is, they don't know the earth word for this treasure - sending our kids scrambling to solve this mystery before they get turned into "shrablitz”!

The challenges will test not only their skills but how far they would go to get that title. As with every competition show, there will be an elimination every week as well as a baker of the week who will be given the red apron. When a Surprise Challenge is given, how would the bakers react to it? Would they perform to their best of their abilities or crumble under pressure? From baking croquembouche towers to Kek Lapis, who can prove that they are truly a Kek Champion? Satu peserta yang cemerlang akan diberikan apron merah untuk disarung sepanjang minggu seterusnya, manakala satu peserta pula akan disingkirkan setiap minggu. Bagaimanakah prestasi peserta apabila diberikan cabaran kejutan? Bagaimana pula mereka mengawal tekanan berada di dapur Kek Champion? Dari menara croquembouche ke Kek Lapis, mereka akan diuji dengan pelbagai cabaran untuk membuktikan mereka layak untuk menjadi juara Kek Champion.

13-year-old Peru is an only child who lives with his mother and grandmother. With his father is seldom in the picture due to his work overseas, a hardworking mother and a kooky grandmother, an awkward comic-loving Peru is left to his own devices as her navigates growing up in a quaint Singapore neighbourhood. One fateful day, through sheer coincidence, Peru finds himself in the living room of the three men-children who for some reason have no problem letting this young kid hang out with them. Arun - the food reviewer, Vijay – the job-hopper and Jagdish – the illustrator make up the menagerie of Peru’s new group of friends. Part immaturity, part aloofness of the three men makes Peru feel like an equal and he begins to open up to them. Peru comes to the house with his growing pain of the week. It’s unusual if the three bachelors actually offer any solutions, but Peru definitely inspires the three men to reflect on their lack of maturity and together the four of them grow up together. The four of them embark on a meaningful journey of friendship that will change their lives forever.

Kavin, a mischievous and endlessly energetic 10-year-old boy, has a knack for turning every classroom into a stage for chaos. Labelled a troublemaker by his teachers, dismissed as lazy by his father, and threatened with expulsion by the school’s stern principal, Ravi, Kavin decides to prove everyone wrong by setting an ambitious goal: winning the prestigious “Best Student Award.” However, his impulsive behaviour and inability to focus make this journey anything but easy. Thankfully, with a Godsent teacher and quirky grandfather, he discovers that while teaching may be hard, learning is never impossible!
